title: Wheat Field Dreamer
description: A Black woman with long braided hair lies in a golden wheat field at night, wearing a flowing white dress, headphones, and a colorful belt. She reaches upward toward a giant floating red wizard hat adorned with vines and stars, while floating islands, a tent, books, and a skeletal hand holding a red vinyl record hover in the starry sky with a glowing light beam.
prompt: A Black woman with long dark braids lies relaxed in a golden wheat field at night, wearing a flowing white dress, silver headphones, and a colorful beaded belt. She reaches one hand upward toward a giant floating red wizard hat covered in green vines and stars. In the starry night sky, small floating islands with grass, a tent, books, and a skeletal hand holding a red vinyl record drift near a bright diagonal beam of light from the top right. Surreal fantasy scene with dramatic lighting and magical atmosphere.
